mapper.select: select count(*) from material_extraction me join paper p on p.paper_id = me.paper_id and p.deleted = false where 1 = 1

select me.paper_id, me.material, me.property, me.confidence, me.method, mm.formatted_value as value, mm.unit,
ts_rank(me.material_fts, plainto_tsquery('simple', #{tsQuery})) as score
1.0 as score
from material_extraction me join paper p on p.paper_id = me.paper_id and p.deleted = false left join lateral ( select case when mm_inner.value_type = 'number' then cast(mm_inner.value_num as varchar) when mm_inner.value_type = 'range' then cast(mm_inner.value_min as varchar) || ' - ' || cast(mm_inner.value_max as varchar) else mm_inner.value_text end as formatted_value, mm_inner.unit from material_metric mm_inner where mm_inner.paper_id = me.paper_id and lower(trim(mm_inner.material_key)) = lower(trim(replace(me.material, ' ', '_'))) order by mm_inner.confidence desc nulls last limit 1 ) mm on true where 1 = 1
order by
score desc,
me.confidence desc nulls last, me.id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
